text.*:
Quester from Citizens1 has been discontinued. There are a few great options that will do everything Quester did and more:

  • Denizen can be used for scripting interactions and events, giving a high level of control over player 'questing', among many other interesting things.
  • MineQuest is an external plugin that can be used with Citizens 2 NPCs. See here
  • Quests By Blackvein is an external plugin that can be used with Citizens 2 NPCs, this offers similar functionality to Citizens1 Quester.
  • Quester An external plugin that can be used with Citizens 2 NPCs.
